entries.title: Psalms 15:1
segments: A Psalm of David. LORD, who shall dwell in Your tabernacle? Who shall dwell on Your holy hill?

entries.title: Psalms 15:2
segments: He who walks uprightly, and works righteousness, and speaks the truth in his heart;

entries.title: Psalms 15:3
segments: [he] does not backbite with his tongue, nor do evil to his neighbor, nor take up a reproach against his neighbor;

entries.title: Psalms 15:4
segments: in whose eyes the reprobate is despised, but he honors those who fear the LORD; [he] has sworn to his hurt, and does not change it;

entries.title: Psalms 15:5
segments: [he] has not put out his money at interest, nor has he taken a bribe against the innocent. He who does these [things] shall not be moved forever.
